paper_metadata.title: Response to “Exponential challenges in unbiasing quantum Monte Carlo algorithms with quantum computers”

summary: This response paper analyzes the QC‑QMC framework using classical simulations of the 1D transverse‑field Ising model for system sizes L=6–12. Using 16 independent simulations (and 128 GFMC runs for energies), the authors show that overlap distributions and measurement scaling depend strongly on Γ/J and on the choice of walker and trial wavefunctions, suggesting that exponential measurement costs observed in prior work may be postponed in some regimes. No quantum hardware experiments or explicit circuit resource estimates are provided.
